feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Anti-migrant activist admits slashing boat with a knife in English Channel
articles.summary: An anti-immigration activist has pleaded guilty to criminal damage after slashing a migrant boat with a knife.

articles.title: Bomb alert at Calais train station affects Eurostar
articles.summary: A bomb alert is under way at a French train station, with Eurostar trains affected.

articles.title: Burnham says climate crisis is 'upon all of us now' and commits UK to 2050 net-zero target
articles.summary: The prime minister has declared the "climate crisis is upon all of us now" and committed the UK to meeting its 2050 net zero target.

articles.title: CCTV images released of night bus driver was shot dead in London
articles.summary: Police believe a bus driver who was shot dead in south London was not the intended target - and was in the wrong place at the wrong time.

articles.title: Sharp rise in deadly antibiotic-resistant infections
articles.summary: Hundreds of people are being diagnosed with potentially life-threatening antibiotic-resistant infections each week, new figures suggest.

articles.title: Team reviewing alleged war crimes did not see key evidence, Afghanistan inquiry told
articles.summary: Key information on photographic evidence was left out when an independent review team was asked to examine whether UK special forces had committed war crimes, an inquiry has heard.

articles.title: Poundland bosses meet to decide firm's future
articles.summary: The directors of crisis-hit Poundland have held a board meeting to decide the company's future, Sky News has been told.

articles.title: Economy grows 0.7% in third quarter but slowdown looms
articles.summary: The UK economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter of the year, according to early official figures confirming a boost from AI investment.

articles.title: Police address 'violent incident' claim against Russell Brand made by Jemima Goldsmith
articles.summary: Police have addressed an alleged "violent incident" involving Russell Brand after claims made by his ex-girlfriend Jemima Goldsmith.
